verdict.summary_en: Korean-language delivery note DN-260809-457 dated 2026.08.09 from Hwaseong Memory Co., Ltd. to Soony Distribution Center Hamburg, against PO 4500318688. It covers one line: CMP-GAM-002 Game Card 64 GB – Grand Heist 5, 20 000 PCS in 40 boxes, total weight 520 kg, carrier Nordhav Shipping A/S. The remarks field is blank. A red supplier stamp and a handwritten receiver signature 'Yilmaz D.' are present. There are no corrections, no received date and no inspection outcome.
observations: Red round stamp 'HWASEONG MEMORY CO LTD' with a star overlaps the quantity, unit and boxes cells. Its edge touches the last digit of '20 000' and its star sits over 'PCS'. The values are still readable.
The stamp carries no date or number.
Handwritten blue signature 'Yilmaz D.' on the receiver (인수자) line. No date is written next to it.
The document shows no received date or receiving stamp. The date in the file name (20260918) does not appear on the paper.
A barcode is printed at the top right.
